target: end-to-end: claim -> context set -> shim tap + tracker advance all carry phase/spec_id
cmd:
mkdir -p factory/specs .agentic; printf '%s' '{"observability":{"enabled":true}}' > .agentic/config.json; printf -- '---
id: 001
title: t
status: specd
---
' > factory/specs/001-t.md; unset CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR AGENTIC_OBSERVE; "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/lib/tracker.sh" claim specd building build-loop >/dev/null; "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/observe.sh" context set --phase build --spec-id factory/specs/001-t.md; printf '%s' '{"worker":"ollama/test","status":"ok","summary":"s","result":"r","artifacts":[],"caveats":[],"usage":{"input_tokens":10,"output_tokens":5}}' | MODEL=test-model OBJECTIVE=obj bash -c 'source "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/lib/obs.sh"; obs_shim_tap' >/dev/null; "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/lib/tracker.sh" advance factory/specs/001-t.md built branch b1 >/dev/null; cat .agentic/observability/events-*.jsonl | jq -cs '{shim: (map(select(.event=="shim_call")) | first), adv: (map(select(.event=="tracker_transition" and .detail.to_status=="built")) | first), claim: (map(select(.event=="tracker_transition" and .detail.to_status=="building")) | first)}'
